name: Immoral Lovers ~Yome ya Gifu ni wa Ienai Katei no Jouji~
original_name: インモラル・ラヴァーズ ～嫁や義父には言えない家庭の情事～
source: The protagonist, Yanamori Takahiro, is bathing his daughter when his mother-in-law, Ninose Yaeko, comes to help. The situation takes an unexpected turn, leading to a secret encounter between him and Yaeko. Later, they act as if nothing happened, and the family gathers for dinner. But it turns up that protagonist's sister-in-law, Ninose Nanami, seems to be up to some mischief under the table. Takahiro wonders what will happen next, as he was just visiting his wife's family to introduce their grandchild.
translation: 主角柳森贵宏正在给女儿洗澡时，岳母二濑弥生前来帮忙。事态却出人意料地发展成了他与弥生之间的秘密邂逅。之后，两人装作什么都没发生过，一家人聚在一起吃晚饭。但贵宏发现，妻妹二濑七海似乎正在桌子底下搞什么小动作。贵宏不禁思考接下来会发生什么，因为他这次只是来妻子家介绍自己的孙辈。
